explication: PlantUML turns textual descriptions into UML and other diagrams. The principal workflow is a user supplying diagram text, the application processing it, and a rendered diagram being produced. The README documents many diagram families and a browser-based TeaVM option; the tree also contains an MCP server. Source excerpts are limited, so relationships beyond the documented workflow are not inferred.
